title: Police Eject Attendees From Diabetes Conference — Did the Association Go Too Far?
summary: As meetings become increasingly vulnerable to political tensions and activism, planners are forced to decide where to draw the line between free expression and disruption.

title: As Event Risks Expand, Industry Revives Security Coalition
summary: Planners are confronting a broader and more complex risk landscape, from violence and cyberattacks to fraud and workplace safety gaps. In response, a long-paused security coalition is being reactivated and expanded to reflect today’s threats.

title: Tehran-Based Event Planner Grapples With Job Loss and Daily Uncertainty
summary: Although there are no longer any restrictions on events in Iran since the ceasefire, there is still little demand from businesses and attendees. Planners remain unemployed and under pressure.

title: Meeting Planning’s Executive Ceiling Problem
summary: Senior planners often say they feel trapped in their roles, with no upward mobility. The good news is that there is opportunity beyond the meeting department.

title: Rio Las Vegas Waives Resort Fees for Groups
summary: As planners scrutinize every line item in event budgets, Rio Las Vegas is turning one of hospitality's most unpopular charges into a competitive advantage. The bigger question is whether other Vegas resorts will feel pressure to match it.

title: What Caesars and MGM Takeover Bids Could Mean for Planners
summary: If both deals close, Caesars and MGM, two of the largest owners of meeting and event space in Las Vegas would move into private hands, potentially reshaping investment priorities, expansion plans, and how major events are negotiated and managed.

title: Europe’s Extreme Heat Creates Challenges for Events
summary: The end of May shattered temperature records across Europe — and it’s not even summer yet. What can planners do to be prepared?

title: SXSW London Panelists Blocked from Entering UK, Blame Israel Stance
summary: The UK's electronic travel authorization has become a speaker vetting tool — and SXSW London just found out the hard way. Event organizers booking outspoken political voices for UK stages now have a new line item in their risk checklist.

title: Hyve Acquired for a Reported $1.8 Billion
summary: Back-to-back deals involving Hyve and Emerald-Questex reflect private equity’s continued confidence in business events.

title: 7 Ways Conference Centers are Adjusting to Changing Attendees
summary: Conference centers used to be known as no-nonsense, even vanilla. Not any more.
